triggers.effectCode: function(ctx, battle, self) { var piece = battle.pieces.find(function(p) { return p.instanceId === self.ownerId; }); if (!piece) return { success: false }; var player = battle.players.find(function(p) { return p.playerId === piece.ownerPlayerId; }); if (!player) return { success: false, message: 'Player not found' }; var result = addCardToHand('lucky-coin', player.playerId); self.expire(); return { success: result, message: (player.name || player.playerId) + ' 获得了幸运币' }; }
